task_prompt: Hold the folded paper and cut it with the handheld shears.
task_summary: The left hand supports folded white paper while the right hand picks up orange-handled shears and repeatedly snips the edge.

objects.name: folded white paper
properties: Thin folded sheet bends while held in the left hand.
Opposed shear blades must cut through the paper layers.
The cut creates a slit from the edge; it does not require severing the entire sheet into two pieces.
objects.evidence: Paper is held at 0-23 s; repeated snips enter its edge near 3-15 s and 19-23 s.

deformation.how_the_task_deforms_it: The sheet bends during handling and is cut locally by the shears.

objects.name: orange handled shears
properties: Two metal blades pivot relative to each other.
Finger pressure on the handles closes the blades through the paper.
Blade closure must produce a material cut in the paper.
objects.evidence: The right hand picks up the shears at 0-2 s and repeatedly closes them at 3-23 s.

subgoals.goal: The paper is held in the left hand.
The shears are held in the right hand.

hand_roles.right: Closes around the orange handles and lifts.

subgoals.action: Repeatedly snip into the folded paper edge.
subgoals.goal: The paper has a slit cut from its edge by the shears.

hand_roles.left: Turns and supports the folded sheet.
hand_roles.right: Repeatedly closes the blades through the edge.

task_success: The paper has a slit cut from its edge by the shears, the paper is held in the left hand.
